question: Should this new External macOS credential surface remain blocked until a real SSH-plus-Screen-Sharing endpoint proves the exact head, or should maintainers explicitly waive that endpoint proof?
rationale: Automated, shim-based, Linux, and Apple VM validation is extensive, but it does not exercise the central credential-bound External macOS provider path; accepting that residual gap requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Require live endpoint proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until redacted evidence demonstrates authenticated External macOS WebVNC preflight, viewer behavior, reset, and cleanup on the exact head.

options.title: Waive provider proof
options.body: Accept the existing automated and shim evidence and record the unavailable task-scoped macOS endpoint as a maintainer-approved proof exception.

recommendation.title: Require live endpoint proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until redacted evidence demonstrates authenticated External macOS WebVNC preflight, viewer behavior, reset, and cleanup on the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and hardened the relevant current-main credential and WebVNC boundaries and are the strongest history-backed owner for this decision.
